༄༅/ /padma tshe yi snying tig las/brgyud 'debs dang*/'chi med mkha' 'gro'i rgyud bskul/skong ba bcas bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: #!"#༄༅// padma tshe yi snying tig las/ brgyud 'debs dang*/ 'chi med mkha' 'gro'i rgyud bskul/ skong ba bcas bzhugs so//

brgyud 'debs ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas rigs kun bdag /longs sku tshe dang ye shes dpag med mgon// sprul pa'i rnam rol padma tsaṇḍa lī// sku gsum dbyer med mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang*// mandā ra ba rje 'bangs grogs gsum dang*// bka' babs 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs// 'chi med rig 'dzin rtsa gsum rab 'byams la// mi phyed rtse gcig gus pas gsol ba 'debs// 'chi bdag la sogs bdud bzhi'i 'jigs las grol// 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma ye shes bcud du grub// tshe gcig 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku thob nas// 'gro kun 'chi med go 'phang la 'god shog / ces pa'ang zab chos 'di yi snod ldan blo gros mtha' yas kyis gsol ba btab pa'o/// / ༈ bgegs gtor/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ gsum gyis byin brlab/ sarba bhū ta ā karṣa ya dzaḥ sa mgron dgug / sarba bhū te bhya na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sogs/ gṛhṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi/ zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis bsngos la bka' bsgo/ 1$0000250༁ྃ: padma tshe yi snying tig las: 'chi med mkha' 'gro'i rgyud bskul bzhugs: 1$0000300'chi med tshe yi lha la 'dud: brgyud gsum thugs dam gnad bskul bas: rdo rje'i ye shes byin 'beb phyir: mda' dar g.yab cing bdug spos 'thul: mos gus gdung shugs bskyed byas la: hrī: 'og min bde chen dbang gi pho brang nas: bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med: yum mchog gsang ba'i lha mo tsaṇḍa lī: yab yum gnyis med rdo rje'i tshe mchog grub: dam pa khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: dbyings nas brtser dgongs rig pa'i thugs rje skyed: 'khor 'das dwangs bcud mi shigs thig ler stims: tshe dang ye shes byin phob dbang mchog skur: oṃ gu ru a mā ra ṇi dzi wānti ye badzra a yu ṣe swā hā: hrī:

dag pa'i zhing mchog ri bo ta la ru: 'jig rten dbang phyug padma gar dbang dang: yum mchog sgrol ma gsang ba ye shes che: yab yum gnyis med rdo rje'i tshe mchog grub: dam pa khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: dbyings nas brtser dgongs rig pa'i thugs rje skyed: 'khor 'das dwangs bcud mi shigs thig ler stims: tshe dang ye shes byin phob dbang mchog skur: oṃ gu ru a mā ra ṇi dzi wānti ye badzra a yu ṣe swā hā: hrī: 'chi med gnas mchog bdud rtsi'i chu klung du: rdor sems dngos snang pra he badzra dang: ye shes mkha' 'gro bde chen rgya mtsho ma: yab yum gnyis med rdo rje'i tshe mchog grub: dam pa khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: dbyings nas brtser dgongs rig pa'i thugs rje skyed: 'khor 'das dwangs bcud mi shigs thig ler stims: tshe dang ye shes byin phob dbang mchog skur: oṃ gu ru a mā ra ṇi dzi wānti ye badzra a yu ṣe swā hā: hrī: rang byung dur khrod so sa gling chen por: rig rtsa dbang thob shrī seng ha dang: ye shes mkha' 'gro bde chen zhi ba mtsho: yab yum gnyis med rdo rje'i tshe mchog grub: dam pa khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: dbyings nas brtser dgongs rig pa'i thugs rje skyed: 'khor 'das dwangs bcud mi shigs thig ler stims: tshe dang ye shes byin phob dbang mchog skur: oṃ gu ru a mā ra ṇi dzi wānti ye badzra a yu ṣe swā hā: hrī: bkra shis brag phug mā ra ti ka ru: bde ba chen po padma badzra dang: tshe lam gsang ba'i grogs mchog mandā ra: yab yum gnyis med rdo rje'i tshe mchog grub: dam pa khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: dbyings nas brtser dgongs rig pa'i thugs rje skyed: 'khor 'das dwangs bcud mi shigs thig ler stims: tshe dang ye shes byin phob dbang mchog skur: oṃ gu ru a mā ra ṇi dzi wānti ye badzra a yu ṣe swā hā:

hrī: ngo mtshar lhun grub gter gyi dur khrod du: paṇa grub dbang po bi ma mi tra dang: 'chi med 'phags ma dbang phyug rgyal mo rtsal: yab yum gnyis med rdo rje'i tshe mchog grub: dam pa khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: dbyings nas brtser dgongs rig pa'i thugs rje skyed: 'khor 'das dwangs bcud mi shigs thig ler stims: tshe dang ye shes byin phob dbang mchog skur: oṃ gu ru a mā ra ṇi dzi wānti ye badzra a yu ṣe swā hā: hrī: gzhan yang rang byung grub pa'i dur khrod du: lha dang dbyer med rig 'dzin slob dpon brgyad: rang rang rigs pa'i pho nya mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: yab yum gnyis med rdo rje'i tshe mchog grub: dam pa khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: dbyings nas brtser dgongs rig pa'i thugs rje skyed: 'khor 'das dwangs bcud mi shigs thig ler stims: tshe dang ye shes byin phob dbang mchog skur: oṃ gu ru a mā ra ṇi dzi wānti ye badzra a yu ṣe swā hā: hrī: brag dmar g.ya' ma lung gi dben gnas su: tshe dpag med mgon o rgyan chen po dang: mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo bde chen mtsho rgyal ma: yab yum gnyis med rdo rje'i tshe mchog grub: dam pa khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: dbyings nas brtser dgongs rig pa'i thugs rje skyed: 'khor 'das dwangs bcud mi shigs thig ler stims: tshe dang ye shes byin phob dbang mchog skur: oṃ gu ru a mā ra ṇi dzi wānti ye badzra a yu ṣe swā hā: hrī: li yul gnas mchog grub pa'i dga' tshal du: lo tsā chen po bai ro tsa na dang: gsang ba'i yum mchog bde chen tshul khrims sgron: yab yum gnyis med rdo rje'i tshe mchog grub: dam pa khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: dbyings nas brtser dgongs rig pa'i thugs rje skyed: 'khor 'das dwangs bcud mi shigs thig ler stims: tshe dang ye shes byin phob dbang mchog skur:

oṃ gu ru a mā ra ṇi dzi wānti ye badzra a yu ṣe swā hā: hrī: lho brag mkhar chu gnyan gyi dben nas su: gnubs kyi slob dpon nam mkha'i snying po dang: sprul pa'i ḍā ki shel dkar rdo rje mtsho: yab yum gnyis med rdo rje'i tshe mchog grub: dam pa khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: dbyings nas brtser dgongs rig pa'i thugs rje skyed: 'khor 'das dwangs bcud mi shigs thig ler stims: tshe dang ye shes byin phob dbang mchog skur: oṃ gu ru a mā ra ṇi dzi wānti ye badzra a yu ṣe swā hā: (hrīḥ gzhom bral bkra shis lha rtse'i pho brang du// gter chen 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje dang*// nyams snang bde ba'i gar mkhan g.yu sgron ma// yab yum gnyis med rdo rje'i tshe mchog grub: dam pa khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: dbyings nas brtser dgongs rig pa'i thugs rje skyed: 'khor 'das dwangs bcud mi shigs thig ler stims: tshe dang ye shes byin phob dbang mchog skur: oṃ gu ru a mā ra ṇi dzi wānti ye badzra a yu ṣe swā hā: shākya shrīs gsung ngo*// oṃ gu ru a mā ra ṇi sarba bidyā dha ra ā yurdzñā na ā be sha ya a ā: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: de ltar 'chi med rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs dam bskul ba sngon du 'gro bas: dkyil 'khor so so'i tshe 'gugs bskul ba gzhung ltar dus drug tu bya'o: dad dang gdung shugs rtse gcig pas: gsol btab thugs dam rgyud bskul bas: tshe dang ye shes byin 'beb cing: 'chi med dngos grub thob par nges: sa ma ya: gu hya: brda thim: dus gsum mkhyen pa o rgyan chen po'i byin rlabs las/ padma mdo sngags gling pa 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje'i gtan la phab pa'o// maṅga laṃ/// / ༁ྃ: padma tshe yi snying tig las: 'chi med mkha' 'gro'i bskang bshags bzhugs: hrī: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i:

nyer spyod 'dod yon sman raka gtor tshogs sogs: mchod rdzas rten rdzas skong rdzas sgrub pa'i rdzas: mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod kyi sprin chen pos: 'chi med rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs dam bskang: rigs bdag tshe dpag med mgon thugs dam bskang: dbyings yum padma ḍākki'i thugs dam bskang: dbang chen rta mgrin rol pa'i thugs dam bskang: las mdzad pho nya'i tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang: yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang: gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang: rdo rje chos srung nor lha'i thugs dam bskang: snang srid gzhir bzhengs dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang: thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chag mthol bshags na: tshangs par mdzad nas tshe dang ye shes sogs: mchog thun dngos grub ma lus bstsal du gsol: yi ge brgya pa brjod: ces pa 'di'ang 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje'i zab mo dgongs pa'i gter las byung ba'o/// / ༈ dpe tshan 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing*/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
